title: Playing with Omar Bernard and trumpeter Bush Hall
summary: He played a long time with Bernard and several jobs with Bush Hall, who played like Buddy Petit.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: And I played with Omar Bernard a long time. And, uh, I played with Omar Bernard a long time. And, uh, I was with them a pretty good while. I'd say for about a year. Then you remember your next band about that you went with? Well, uh, in fact, they was the first band I played with. Then after I left them, I went with Omar Bernard.
Oh, that was after, that was before Omar. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. And I played with Omar Bernard a long time. And, uh, there was a trumpet player around here. I don't know if you ever heard of him. Bush Hall.
He was a good little trumpet player. He played something on the order of Buddy Petit.
He made a lot of chromatics. Well, I played with him several jobs, you know. Yeah.
